name: Live PID Detection, Account Discovery & 10-Minute Quota Sync Engine
requirements: Implement sync_instance_pid_and_quota_logic in instance.rs: detect live running PID via find_pids_for_data_dir/is_instance_running, read active authenticated account email from state.vscdb via db::read_injected_email, reconcile bound account, and refresh quota via account::fetch_quota_with_retry
Implement sync_all_instances_and_quotas_logic in instance.rs iterating across all instances
Expose sync_instance_pid_and_quota and sync_all_instances_and_quotas commands in commands/instance.rs and lib.rs
Add start_instance_pid_quota_scheduler in scheduler.rs running every 600s (10 minutes) to keep running instances, PIDs, and credits updated automatically
